recommendations.summary: Block mobile apps on Display (placements dominated by games/utilities). Applied: excluded mobileappcategory::69500 + lakesidemtconstruction.com, plumbertip.com, jqrkjxh.com, urongames.top.

Competitor terms handled via new $1.00 CPC "Competitor terms" ad groups (CA + US ex CA) instead of negatives. 10 phrase keywords; ads copied from approved Apply ads. "californialifeline com" rejected by policy.
All Search ad group max CPCs set to $2.00 (Apply/SNAP were $3.50; others $2.50). Keyword-level bid overrides cleared (root cause of CPCs exceeding caps). Bid strategy already Manual CPC.
Rewrite Poor-strength Assurance and Near me ads. Awaiting Javier approval of new copy (approved baseline must be preserved).

Daily 1% review (Nov 9 vs Nov 8): $2.00 caps worked, clicks +30% (91 to 118) on +4% spend, avg CPC $1.20 to $0.96 (-20%), clicks per dollar +25%. Proposed: (1) add phrase negative "assurance" to CA Search and US ex CA Search (Assurance-brand queries spent $7.68 to date at 8-9% CTR, off-policy for non-branded rule); (2) block all mobile apps on CA Display via placement exclusion adsenseformobileapps.com plus solvedlib.com (apps still serving: 8 of top 10 Display placements, $14.52 of $109.16, about 13%). Expected: about $2/day of Search and $2.50/day of Display moved to relevant traffic. Awaiting Javier's yes; nothing applied.

Daily 1% review (Nov 10 vs Nov 9): total spend $126.64 vs $113.87 (+11%), clicks 211 vs 119 (+77%), avg CPC $0.60 vs $0.96 (-38%), driven by CA Demand Gen launch (~93 clicks for ~$20.85, ~$0.22 CPC). Search/Display alone: 118 vs 119 clicks on $105.80 vs $113.87 (-7%). CA Search CPC $1.97 (-6%), clicks/$ +6%, CTR 17.5% vs 27.7%; Nationwide CPC $1.78 (-15%), clicks/$ +18%; Display flat at $0.28 CPC. No post-split enrollment report yet, so recommendations are ready for when Javier has seen it. Proposed: (1) add phrase negatives 'airtalk' and 'air talk' to the non-competitor ad groups in CA Search and US ex CA Search so AirTalk queries ($21.87 all-time, 8 clicks, ~$2.70/click in high-CPC groups) route to the $1.00 Competitor terms groups; expected ~$2-3/day saved. (2) exclude savenowy.com and mydrawingstar.com on CA Display (junk sites, $2.11 all-time); small but clean. Nothing applied.

dailyReports.notes: SafeLink daily report rows by promo code. Pre-split (before 2026-11-09 15:40 ET): segmentId "all", promoCode ABJ0020 (all campaigns shared one code). Promo-code split went live in Google Ads on 2026-11-09 at about 3:40 PM ET. From that time: one row set per promo — ABJ0020=nationwide, ABJ0021=ca_search, ABJ0022=ca_display, ABJ0023=ca_demand_gen. Nov 9 is a partial split day: before ~3:40 PM ET all clicks went to ABJ0020, so Nov 9 per-code spend is an approximation that attributes each campaign's full-day Google Ads spend to that campaign's code. Do not reassign pre-split rows to Nationwide. Payout confirmed only in biweekly reports. dailyReports.byPromoCode is the cumulative tally from 2026-11-09 on (costPerApplicationUsd = spend / total applications of every status; costPerQualifiedUsd = spend / qualified).
